hyperedges.label: Self-hosted monitoring stack on Oracle Cloud

nodes.label: /api/health endpoint (src/pages/api/health.ts)
nodes.rationale: Tests Supabase connection server-side and returns 503 when broken; the most useful check

nodes.label: Beszel
nodes.rationale: Server metrics (CPU, RAM, disk, network, Docker containers); hub on 127.0.0.1:8090

nodes.label: Beszel agent (oracle-prod, port 45876)
nodes.rationale: Started after hub so its public key (BESZEL_KEY) can be copied into monitoring/.env

nodes.label: ntfy push notifications
nodes.rationale: Simplest free option without account; topic name must be non-guessable

nodes.label: Reverse proxy (Caddy or nginx)
nodes.rationale: Caddy gives automatic HTTPS; nginx requires certbot

nodes.label: Uptime Kuma
nodes.rationale: Availability checks of site, /api routes, Supabase endpoint and SSL expiry; bound to 127.0.0.1:3001 behind reverse proxy; needs WebSocket proxying

nodes.label: Oracle Cloud two-level firewall (VCN Security List + OS firewall)
nodes.norm_label: oracle cloud two-level firewall (vcn security list + os firewall)
nodes.rationale: Classic Oracle Cloud trap: ports 80/443 must be opened both in VCN and OS (iptables/firewalld); 3001 and 8090 stay on localhost so only the reverse proxy reaches them

nodes.label: PWA mobile install
nodes.rationale: No app store publishing needed; install from mobile browser home screen
